$description: Sound events. Each token's value is the cue's maximum length; the audio files arrive with Lane J in design/sounds/. Every cue is original, under one second, and loudness-normalised to -18 LUFS short-term.

gate-needs-you.$description: A human gate is waiting: a rising two-note chime, warm, never alarming.

run-finished.$description: A run or phase finished: a bright resolving triad.

ultra-pass-finished.$description: An ULTRA improvement pass completed and the next begins: a shimmering upward arpeggio.

failed.$description: A job failed or was parked: a soft falling minor third.

parked.$description: A job parked for later: a single muted pluck.

budget-step.$description: A budget threshold was crossed: two even ticks.

unlimited-spend-reminder.$description: The unlimited-budget reminder: a low, patient pulse.

device-paired.$description: A device paired: a quick two-tone handshake.

tap.$description: A UI acknowledgement, used sparingly: a near-silent click.
